g.text: artifact identifier; input/version record
Artifact means a saved lyric or audio result. Its key
records the inputs/settings used to produce it.

tspan.style: font-style: oblique; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #647f4b
font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #647f4b

g.text: start/end beat positions
The part of the song this result would cover if played.
An interval describes where, not whether it is usable.

font-style: oblique; font-size: 8.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #647f4b

g.text: ready / valid / ownership / policy tests
Is it finished and intact, from the correct session,
and allowed under the selected playback policy?

g.text: beats
The current point reached in the musical timeline.
Ready coverage is measured forward from here.

g.text: ordered preference list
Which alternative to try when fresh model audio is
unavailable: older audio, robotic speech or replay.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #647f4b

g.text: Eligibility class

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #566171

g.text: fresh-only or fallback-permitted, etc.
A named set of rules for what counts as usable.
Fresh-only and continuity can accept different results.

g.text: required input/version for output j
Fresh must match this requirement. A later edit
does not retroactively make committed audio wrong.

Required-version prepared audio finishes before its
deadline and passes eligibility. Not acoustic proof.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #647f4b

g.text: Continuity vs freshness
Continuity: no unintended gap.
Freshness: output matches required inputs.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #647f4b

g.text: WHY ONE GROUP?
A buffer count is misleading without checking which versions are usable and where gaps occur.
A replay can keep time without providing new lyrics; report fresh output and uninterrupted output separately.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #647f4b

g.text: ready
Unbroken ready lead = 1 bar, not 3.
The third bar cannot fill the second.
Check fresh-only coverage separately from
coverage that permits fallback audio.
